integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard Ritt characterizations, spectral mapping, and elementary polynomial functional calculus. No numerical experiment or finite search is used as a proof step.
scientific_limitations: Assumes that at least one positive power is already a Ritt operator.
Stated for complex Banach spaces and does not optimize the resulting Ritt constants.
Residual originality risk: an equivalent fixed-operator power-root lemma may exist under older finite-peripheral-spectrum terminology.
title: Exact divisibility law for Ritt powers
